Use the exact same native parent model transform/scale/yaw/origin offset; candidate planes are already attached and normalized in that parent basis. Do not apply tag matrices a second time.

Copy only the candidate local-original/sails-native subtree into active local-original when Root authorizes production promotion; do not publish original media to Git.

previewLimit: Actual GLES renders source initial composite with neutralDiffuse.25 to inspect unchanged texture RGB. It is not a browser/original screenshot, a native-climate lighting comparison or a dynamic-cloth parity claim.
limits: Native spring/LCG wind/deformed normals are exported but unported. The production candidate intentionally retains the native initial plane only.
Damage masks00..08 are preserved but automatic HP/event selection is not activated by this helper.
BoatWake source classes and their native idle/move/sink models are separately identified, not reproduced by generic particles.
The helper is isolated and cannot be treated as already integrated production rendering. Root owns runtime promotion and Main/renderer hooks.
